ActiveCreditAccountNotSetException().notice: Thrown when attempting to execute a protocol interaction without active credit account set

ActiveCreditAccountOverridenException().notice: Thrown when Credit Facade tries to write over a non-zero active Credit Account

AllowanceFailedException().notice: Thrown if an attempt to approve a collateral token to adapter's target contract fails

CallerNotAdapterException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as allowed adapter

CallerNotConfiguratorException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as configurator

CallerNotCreditFacadeException().notice: Thrown on attempting to call an access restricted function not as credit facade

CloseAccountWithNonZeroDebtException().notice: Thrown when attempting to close an account with non-zero debt

CreditAccountDoesNotExistException().notice: Thrown on attempting to perform an action for a credit account that does not exist

DebtToZeroWithActiveQuotasException().notice: Thrown when trying to repay all debt while having active quotas

DebtUpdatedTwiceInOneBlockException().notice: Thrown when trying to update credit account's debt more than once in the same block

InsufficientRemainingFundsException().notice: Thrown when value of funds remaining on the account after liquidation is insufficient

NotEnoughCollateralException().notice: Thrown on failing a full collateral check after multicall

TargetContractNotAllowedException().notice: Thrown on attempting to interact with an address that is not a valid target contract

TokenAlreadyAddedException().notice: Thrown on attempting to add a token that is already in a collateral list

TokenNotAllowedException().notice: Thrown on attempting to receive a token that is not a collateral token or was forbidden

TooManyEnabledTokensException().notice: Thrown if more than the maximum number of tokens were enabled on a credit account

TooManyTokensException().notice: Thrown on configurator attempting to add more than 255 collateral tokens

UpdateQuotaOnZeroDebtAccountException().notice: Thrown when a zero-debt account attempts to update quota

ZeroAddressException().notice: Thrown on attempting to set an important address to zero address

userdoc.notice: Credit manager implements core logic for credit accounts management.         The contract itself is not open to neither external users nor the DAO: users should use `CreditFacadeV3`         to open accounts and perform interactions with external protocols, while the DAO can configure manager         params using `CreditConfiguratorV3`. Both mentioned contracts perform some important safety checks.
